sources.supports: The linked official page currently returns 404. Current call terms and continued program availability could not be verified.

Official page says the 2026 cycle is closed; lists proposal due January 15, 2026, scholar application due February 1, 2026, U.S. citizenship, enrollment at a participating university in a thesis-bearing program, and 16 research areas.
Official events archive includes the Research Fellowships 2022 announcement and does not show a newer fellowship cycle. The legacy fellowship URL redirects to Events & Programs.

Official Bloomberg story confirms the program was active for the 2021–2022 fellows and describes financial aid, professional support, mentorship and research internships. Current cycle page and dates were not verifiable in this check.

Official 2026 page states the application period was June 22–August 23, 2026 (23:59 UTC) and is closed; selected projects are funded for one year; eligibility is university professors/researchers whose university accepts the GRO Research Agreement; it explicitly excludes equipment/cash donations, student projects, event sponsorships, and teaching. The page lists scientific AI, quantum computing, next-generation energy storage and semiconductor wastewater treatment among 2026 themes; no fixed award amount is published.
